weather.note: The north-east monsoon starts: the north coast and the east are often grey and wet (Jiufen, Keelung, Yilan, Hualien). Taipei itself is drier.
The south is dry and sunny in Nov. Alishan about 7–17°C with afternoon fog; Sun Moon Lake mild.
weather.sky: sunny in Tainan, foggy in the hills

weather.note: Start of the north-east monsoon: passing showers but much less rain than Hualien and the north; the sea is still about 26°C.
Usually the best time of year. Pu Luong 15–26°C, Sapa cooler (about 10–20°C) with morning fog.

weather.note: Crisp and clear. Koyasan's leaves peak late Oct–early Nov; Kyoto city colours start mid-Nov.

jp-kansai.entry: Visa-free 90 days · Visit Japan Web QR for customs

weather.note: Tokyo mild. Takayama 2–16°C, Hirayu and Kamikochi near freezing at night; larches golden early Nov (Kamikochi closes 15 Nov). November is Fuji's clearest month.
Pleasant. Aso 5–15°C, Kuju near freezing at night.
Hokuriku turns wet in November as the winter monsoon starts ('forget your lunch, not your umbrella', they say in Kanazawa). Crisp between fronts; snow already at Murodo (2,450 m).
